crossRefs.note: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.
He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord…

translations.web: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.
translations.bsb: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that area.
translations.kjv: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
